data.title: Ramp Explorer Challenge!
data.description: Explore how changing the angle and surface of a ramp affects the push needed to move your load up safely.

challenges.title: Wheel or Box?
challenges.brief: The loads have the same weight and climb the same ramp. Which setup needs less push?
challenges.hint: Rolling contact usually resists motion less than a sliding surface.
challenges.explainOnSolve: The wheel has less resistance, so less of the push is spent overcoming friction.

challenges.title: Steep or Gentle?
challenges.brief: Everything is identical except the ramp angle. Which setup needs less push?
challenges.hint: Ask how much gravity points back down each ramp.
challenges.explainOnSolve: On the gentler ramp, a smaller part of gravity pulls the load downhill, so the required push is lower.

challenges.title: Rough or Smooth?
challenges.brief: The box, weight, and angle stay fixed. Which surface needs less push?
challenges.explainOnSolve: The smooth surface produces less friction, leaving more of the applied force available to move the box.

challenges.title: Choose the Easier Route
challenges.brief: The barrel and surface are unchanged. Which route needs less push?
challenges.hint: Compare the slopes, not the drawing labels or positions.
challenges.explainOnSolve: The gentler route reduces the downhill component of gravity, so it needs less input force.
